title: Bohr phenomenon for certain integral operators and transforms in complex Banach spaces
summary: In this paper, we investigate several Bohr radii associated with the Cesáro operator, Bernardi integral operator, $β$-Cesáro operator, and discrete Fourier transform, all defined on a set of holomorphic mappings from the unit ball of a complex Banach space into the closure of the unit polydisc $\mathbb{D}^n$ within the space $\mathbb{C}^n$.
